A commercial greenhouse tomato operation growing vine tomatoes has seen marketable yield fall about 30% over two growing cycles, and the shortfall has repeated across successive plantings. The decline set in after a switch to a new irrigation-water source following a well upgrade. Determine what is really driving the loss and what to do about it.
